extraction: Rectifiable Banach-valued line integration is defined through Riemann–Stieltjes sums. Theorem 4.1 gives Cauchy vanishing for finite closed rectifiable families with zero winding outside the analytic domain. Formula 4.5 defines the calculus; Proposition 4.6 proves independence for positive simple systems.
translation: Use the Banach algebra of bounded operators on each complex Banach space. The common manuscript cycle avoids both spectra. Its difference with a standard positive system has zero winding outside U minus the relevant spectrum; Theorem 4.1 therefore identifies its integral with formula 4.5. Integer multiplicities are repeated oriented components. Zero spaces are handled separately.
verdict: External foundational implication verified after explicit inference from Theorem 4.1; not a Lean formalization.
classification: Formal corollary not stated at this general cycle scope.
